newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - EVEREN upgrades First Bank.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - EVEREN upgrades First Bank.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Friday it raised its six-month rating on First Bank System Inc to outperform from market performer.
-- It said First Bank's merger with U.S. Bancorp would double its asset base, enhance earnings and position the company for further expansion.

-- EVEREN reduced its 1998 EPS estimate to $5.90 from $6.05, with the reduction heavily weighted to the first half of the year. "Our forecast has the transaction being accretive to earnings per share beginning in the Q3 of 1998," EVEREN said in a report. First Bank was up 2-1/4 at 77-3/4.
